# Twenty-six

"È finita," her grandmother said — not sadly, the way you'd say it about
a season. "È finita, e va bene così."

The café on Main had a sign in the window that said CLOSED, and under it,
in a smaller hand, {~~“back soon”~>“back in the spring”~~}.

She counted: three sisters, two brothers, one boat, forty-one years.
